items.summary: BlackRock-owned HPS is seeking $9.5 billion in equity commitments for its latest direct-lending fund, following a $21.1 billion fundraising milestone in 2024.

items.title: Life after Huang at Nvidia, Anthropic plans to raise IPO price after strong investor demand
items.summary:
Siebert Financial chief investment officer Mark Malek and his panel of experts weigh in on Nvidia's recent earnings call and what life at Nvidia will look like without former CEO Jensen Huang. Plus, Anthropic is preparing for its IPO and plans to raise the share price above its initial price range.

Today's panel includes TMX Wall Street Horizon Head of Corporate Event Research Christine Short, Howard Capital Management CEO and Portfolio Manager Vance Howard, Wellington-Altus Chief Market Strategist Jim Thorne, and Amplify ETFs CEO Christian Magoon.

items.title: Record Money Is Pouring Into the ETFs That Own Anthropic, So Who Is Really Buying?
items.summary: ETFs holding private AI darlings are swallowing a wildly outsized share of investor cash, yet the buyers aren't the retail crowd you'd expect. A clever trade is hiding in plain sight, and it comes with an expiration date.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Are Bleeding Cash. What IBIT Holders Should Watch Next
items.summary: IBIT has shed billions in a matter of weeks, and one lone inflow day hasn't changed the story. Three fund signals and one Fed tool could reveal whether holders are truly capitulating or just pausing.

items.title: BlackRock (BLK) Seeks ETIF Approval As Valuation Debate Comes Into View
items.summary: BlackRock (BLK) is back in focus after seeking regulatory approval for a new exchange traded interval fund structure, which aims to blend ETF style intraday trading with periodic share repurchases. Recent headlines around BlackRock range from fresh Bitcoin ETF flows to private credit fundraising and large bank clients increasing exposure to its products. Yet the share price has eased 1.4% over the past day and 3.4% over the past week, while still delivering an 8.8% year to date share price...

items.title: EFG International appoints Tuan Huynh as Asia CIO and DPM head
items.summary: Based in Singapore, Huynh will manage the Asia DPM team and take responsibility for EFG’s investment strategy in the region.
